findings.title: Python terminal outcome ambiguity or explicit failure can be accepted
findings.reproduction: One Ran 2 tests summary followed by FAILED (failures=1) and OK, in either order; also OK (failures=1).
findings.observed: validate_readback accepts all three using the actual frozen base helper. test_observations keeps only the last terminal count details; the OK terminal match in the base helper is not exclusive.
findings.impact: If a zero-exit wrapper emits contradictory or malformed summaries, extra row can become PASS despite raw FAILED/nonzero failure counts. The ordinary nonzero process exit remains FAIL; this is not a claim that the actual native run failed.
findings.minimum_fix: In extra layer preserve all terminal matches, require exactly one OK with valid aggregate counts, reject any FAILED, failures>0, errors>0 or unexpected successes>0. Keep original32 helper bytes fixed.

findings.title: Trailing unassigned libtest output is omitted from harness reconciliation
findings.reproduction: Append running 1 test and test late_unreported_failure ... FAILED after the last complete valid workspace summary, without another summary/dispatch record.
findings.observed: Global test rows include one FAILED but totals.failed=0, execution_order_unambiguous=true, required_roster_complete=true, and validate_readback accepts.
findings.impact: Contradictory/incomplete trailing test output can be excluded from per-harness totals. A native nonzero Cargo exit still prevents component success.
findings.minimum_fix: Require every recognized running/test/summary event to belong to exactly one completed harness; reject trailing or otherwise unassigned events and reconcile all-stream test rows with all harness rows.

reviewed_safe_properties: Multi-harness compilation/dispatched inventory, required nonzero Node target and unit-group roster, complete workspace membership, filtered/measured refusal and missing/extra summaries are checked.
NO_TESTS and fully IGNORED harnesses remain separately labelled; zero execution in required targets/groups blocks.
run_command retains native nonzero exit and parses failed output; watchdog outcomes are not normal PASS.
Fresh export roots must be absent before the single workspace producer; readers only consume manifests from that run and exact explicit --raw-dir paths.
Reader report digest, packet inventory and limited-authority flags are checked; manifests are checked before each reader and after all readers.
Preflight/source admission failure stops further dispatch; final source guard is attempted even after failure; all row passed flags and failures control components_passed.
The exact original32 helper SHA256 is checked before compile of its already-read bytes and again at final observation.
Production, public-network, original-resource, whole-chain-PQ and throughput qualification fields remain false.

identity_interpretation.observed: Cargo compiler JSON identifies intended artifacts; Cargo stderr identifies dispatch paths; files are hashed after the command.
identity_interpretation.not_observed: No operating-system /proc executable or actual model/DSO load observation is made by this extra runner.
identity_interpretation.recommendation: Explicitly record CARGO_DISPATCH_AND_POST_RUN_FILE_HASH and os_loaded_identity=NOT_OBSERVED to prevent promotion of file hashes.

original32_failure_interpretation: Extra components_passed covers only its own 17 commands and does not consume the original32 summary. Both receipts must remain separate; original32 FAIL must remain in the final overall integration report.
actions: Findings and exact reproducer sent to root and consensus_audit; no candidate files edited.
